message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Lowest RMSE among all candidate structures, indicating the best fit to observed target positions while accounting for combined sensor bias, velocity offset, and speed step effects.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Second-lowest RMSE, suggesting velocity offset and speed step together explain most of the position deviation without needing sensor bias.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "Third-lowest RMSE, showing that sensor bias combined with velocity offset provides a strong explanation for the observed tracking error.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Fourth-lowest RMSE, indicating sensor bias and speed step together fit the data better than single-factor models.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "VELOCITY_OFFSET", "rationale": "Single-factor model with low RMSE, suggesting a constant velocity offset alone explains much of the deviation from nominal positions.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SPEED_STEP", "rationale": "Single-factor model with low RMSE comparable to velocity offset, indicating a speed step change could explain the observed position drift.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "Single-factor model with moderate RMSE, suggesting a constant sensor bias contributes to the observed position error but is insufficient alone.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "ACTUATOR_DELAY", "rationale": "Highest RMSE among single-factor models, indicating actuator delay alone is the weakest explanation for the observed tracking deviations.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
